title: Nalar: Building My Own Blog CMS From Scratch
sub: No WordPress, no Ghost, no static-site generator. A full-stack blog with its own CMS: Markdown with live preview, scheduled posts, tags, full-text search and real authentication, running on a mini PC under my desk.

title: Crop Disease Detector
sub: Building an AI that identifies plant diseases from a single leaf photo: the dataset, the two-phase transfer learning, the numbers it reaches, and the honest limits of what it can claim.
